title: HR onboarding and termination checklist, tickets and background-check records
source_system: HR files and HR tickets
what_it_shows: Identity provider accounts are requested by HR ticket at hire; at termination HR emails the Front Office Manager and IT, and the checklist has no PMS removal step; background-check company invoices cover managers and front office hires; background-check reports are printed and filed in a locked HR cabinet with no disposal procedure

title: Employee handbook
source_system: HR files
what_it_shows: Code of conduct and general discipline section; no section on information security

title: PMS user and permission export
source_system: PMS admin console (SYS-01)

title: PMS security settings, role configuration, interface accounts and report history
source_system: PMS admin console (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Role permissions enforced and new users denied until a role is assigned; lockout after 6 failed attempts; PMS password length setting recorded; activity records show user, time, action and record; the user activity report has no runs in its history; PMS-to-lock and POS-to-PMS interface credentials have no change date since installation

title: Vendor remote access tool settings
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console; lock vendor remote support tool

title: Endpoint console export, asset list, PC build document and patch report
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console
what_it_shows: 34 Windows PCs and laptops (6 front desk, 2 reservations, 26 back office and managers), 5 POS stations and 12 staff tablets; standard MSP PC build; standard users are not local administrators; monthly OS patching on PCs, with the lock server outside the patch policy; anti-malware on all 34 PCs; no endpoint detection and response agent; 2 front desk PCs share one Windows login; 15-minute screen lock with the 2 shared front desk PCs excluded; PCs take time from an internet time service; host firewall settings not set by policy on manager laptops; the asset list holds PCs and tablets but not the front desk terminals, P2PE devices or lock system

title: Anti-malware console settings and alert mailbox sample
source_system: Anti-malware management console; MSP alert mailbox
what_it_shows: Signature anti-malware with automatic updates, scheduled and real-time scans on the 34 PCs; no agent on the lock server; alerts go to an MSP mailbox, and the sample shows alerts with no recorded follow-up

title: Network documentation, firewall configuration and staff Wi-Fi settings
source_system: MSP network documentation; firewall and Wi-Fi controller management
what_it_shows: One staff network holds the front desk PCs and terminals, back office PCs, the lock server and the CCTV recorder; the firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic and allows all outbound traffic; staff Wi-Fi joins the same network and its passphrase was last changed in 2021; one internet provider; no record of firewall rule reviews

title: Guest Wi-Fi and TV network design
source_system: Wi-Fi and TV vendor documentation
what_it_shows: Guest Wi-Fi and TV run on separate vendor-managed networks with internet access only and client isolation

title: Log settings export
source_system: Firewall, MSP console, PMS, identity provider and cloud logging settings
what_it_shows: PMS, identity provider and cloud tenant record user activity with default retention; the firewall keeps a small local log that overwrites; PCs and the lock server do not send logs anywhere; no log review schedule configured

title: Email security and shared mailbox settings
source_system: Productivity suite admin console (SYS-11)

title: Lock system service report
source_system: Door lock vendor service portal (SYS-08)

title: Payment device lists and P2PE documents

title: Receipt and folio samples

title: CCTV recorder and time clock settings

title: Cloud account inventory and configuration export

title: Cloud provider SOC 2 report and shared responsibility documentation

title: Accounts payable vendor list, July 2025 to June 2026
source_system: Accounting system
what_it_shows: Payments to the PMS vendor, payment gateway, POS vendor and P2PE solution provider, booking engine vendor, channel manager vendor, guest Wi-Fi and TV vendor, door lock vendor, revenue-management vendor, chatbot vendor, web agency, background-check company, staffing company, MSP, identity provider, productivity suite (including an enterprise generative AI assistant add-on), cloud provider, timekeeping and payroll vendor, shredding vendor and cyber insurer

title: Vendor contracts review
source_system: Controller's contracts folder
what_it_shows: PMS contract has no recovery time or recovery point terms; revenue-management contract lets the vendor pool the hotel's non-public rate and occupancy data into a market benchmark; chatbot contract has no transcript retention or card masking terms; channel manager contract has a confidentiality clause and no PCI terms; timekeeping vendor terms do not address finger template handling

title: Web agency contract, hosting summary and repository summary
source_system: Web agency documents
what_it_shows: The agency hosts the hotel website behind a web application firewall service and built the chatbot integration and the guest-marketing hub; the contract sets no secure development requirements; the repository summary shows no code review step; booking link changes have no change record

title: Revenue-management system configuration and vendor assurance
source_system: Revenue-management vendor console (SYS-12)
what_it_shows: Live since 2024; daily rate recommendations publish automatically to the PMS, booking engine and channel manager; no floor, ceiling or emergency rule configured; personalized pricing feature off; vendor local accounts without MFA; settings change log available; vendor provides a SOC 2 Type 1 report only; the nightly extract from the reporting database includes guest names

title: Chatbot vendor console export
source_system: Chatbot vendor console (SYS-13)
what_it_shows: Live since March 2026 on the website and text messaging; about 2,400 conversations a month; transcripts kept with no retention limit; no card-number masking setting; rate answers take the base nightly rate from the PMS availability feed through the integration

title: Booking engine configuration and change record
source_system: Booking engine vendor console (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: Booking and payment page on the vendor's own web address, linked from the hotel website; the hotel receives a token; the displayed total price has included the $35 amenity fee since a May 2025 change

title: AI tool review
source_system: Identity provider app list; productivity suite license report; questions to department heads

title: FY2025 financial statements
source_system: Accounting system

source_system: PMS reporting (SYS-01)

source_system: Interviews (General Manager, Controller, Front Office Manager, Revenue Manager, Director of Sales and Marketing, Chief Engineer, MSP lead technician)

source_system: Interviews (majority owner, General Manager, Controller, Front Office Manager, Director of Sales and Marketing, Chief Engineer, MSP lead technician, IT Manager)

what_it_shows: Booking engine shows the total price including the amenity fee, and taxes and the final amount before payment; the website 'rates from' banner shows the base rate without the fee; the website fee description lists valet parking, which the rate sheet charges separately; the phone script states the fee after the rate
